title: カワイイ＋バイブス＝バズ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm… What to do. I wonder if I can give this a bit more oomph…

text_block_list.text: Wahey, Currers! You're totes cute today! ☆ Like, slay! ♪

text_block_list.text: Waaaheeey! My aura's always, like, so open and inviting! ☆ Amirite?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sooo, could you share some of that aura and help me freshen up my Umastagram post?

text_block_list.text: Freshen up? What, is it straight cheugy? ☆

text_block_list.text: It really is! I want you to rewrite it and give it more punch! It's super dull right now!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I wanna use my next post to promote my race, but the draft's looking way too basic right now.

text_block_list.text: That's so mid! I'm finna boost these vibes! It's gonna hit different fr fr!

text_block_list.text: Thanks so much! ♪ We should snap a pic together too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm gonna post this pic. ♪ Here's what I want you to write about in the post…

text_block_list.name: @Curren
text_block_list.text: So here's what's up! [?] Saturday is [?] At the racecourse [?][?][?][?] [?][?][?][?]

text_block_list.text: Uh… I guess my phone can't display these emoji. But what's going on with Curren Chan anyway? …I should go see this race.

text_block_list.text: …Hehe. ☆ That was a publicity success for sure! Probably! ♪
